covered.label: Luas Red and Green Lines
covered.detail: 65 of 67 Luas tram stops, live NTA GTFS-RT predictions only - a tram only appears once the realtime feed is actually confirming it, never backfilled from the printed timetable.

notCovered.label: Connolly Luas stop
notCovered.detail: No real-time data from the NTA feed; use Busaras. Red trams still show 'Red + Connolly' as a direction chip further up the line - that names where the tram is going, not a board you can open at Connolly itself.

notCovered.label: Saggart Luas stop
notCovered.detail: No real-time data from the NTA feed; use Fortunestown.

notCovered.label: DART / Iarnrod Eireann (commuter and intercity rail)
notCovered.detail: Not covered - Luas only, in this version.

notCovered.label: Dublin Bus, Go-Ahead Ireland, Bus Eireann

stations: 65 Luas stops across the Red and Green Lines (Connolly and Saggart excluded - no real-time coverage in the NTA feed, see notCovered).
notes: This app covers the Luas Red and Green lines only - it doesn't show DART or bus times. Abbey Street is the Red Line hub; the Green Line interchange (Marlborough / O'Connell - GPO / O'Connell Upper) is a short walk away, not the same stop. Connolly and Saggart aren't shown because the operator's live feed doesn't carry real-time times for those two stops - use Busaras instead of Connolly, and Fortunestown instead of Saggart. A few stops, including termini such as Broombridge, can sometimes go several minutes without a live time even though the tram is still running; when that happens the app tells you so on screen rather than just showing a blank board.
